name: Anhui Truchum Advanced Materials and Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Truchum Advanced Materials and Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufactures, and sale of advanced copper-based and military-grade carbon materials in China and internationally. It offers copper alloy plate and strip products, such as brass, red copper and tin/phosphor bronze series products for use in military, coinage, energy conservation, automobiles, and high-speed rails industry; and high-end copper conductor products, including conductive copper rod, high-precision electrical round copper wire, tinned soft round copper wire, soft copper stranded wire, and other series.
